notes: Invented content: fan concepts (AI_CONCEPT) and speculation (SPECULATION). None of this is from Rockstar. Every line must contain its hedge phrase (Imagine / Picture / In this concept / speculation) so the narration never presents it as fact, and every video shows the matching label on screen. 'anchor' is an optional CONFIRMED_FACT from fact-bank.json shown first ('here's the official part').
